author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Recently featured on Tindie, the MultiCM Flasher is a parallel programming device designed to flash multiple Raspberry Pi Compute Module variants simultaneously. The device supports eMMC-based Compute Modules across several generations, including CM3, CM3+, CM4S, CM4, and CM5. The MultiCM Flasher is designed for programming up to seven Compute Modules in parallel, with support for […]
title: MultiCM Flasher enables parallel programming of Raspberry Pi Compute Modules
